slides.sub: How to make both work. Swipe.

slides.title: IT'S A WORKOUT
slides.head: The club session is a hard day. Count it as one.
slides.body: Don't stack your plan's hard session on top of it in the same week.

slides.title: MOVE THE DAY
slides.head: Put your plan's quality session on club night.
slides.body: Same work, same week. Just with company.

slides.title: EASY EITHER SIDE
slides.head: Keep the day before and after easy.
slides.body: Hard days back to back is how niggles start.

slides.title: PICK YOUR GROUP
slides.head: Run with the group that matches your session.
slides.body: Chasing the fast bunch on an easy week is not the plan.

slides.title: HOLD BACK
slides.head: In race week, run it gently or skip the hard reps.
slides.body: Your club will still be there after the race.

slides.sub: Your club runs go straight into your plan.
